source.verification_notes: Official Apple technical-specification HTML archived with a SHA-256 sidecar; page identity matched 'Apple Watch Series 7'; 10 specification sections extracted. notes: Technical specification sections are transcribed from the archived model-specific Apple Support page; every section retains its own source URL and archive path.
Model identity/year evidence is separately sourced from https://support.apple.com/en-ie/108056, archived at apple_watch_extraction/technical_specs_html/apple-watch-model-identification.html.
This is an archival-first extraction; normalized values have not been inferred from the section text.
